title: T-Connector Do’s
slide_intent: Use a recognizable shape to join related content so the composition itself communicates connection.
strategic_value: A T-Digit bridging a claim and a relevant scene can make T-Mobile’s connection promise part of the layout.
demonstration: Two wide examples bridge a magenta message panel and photograph with a white T-Digit, reversing sides in the second.
practical_value: Pair related content and cover the joining edge completely with the T-Digit.

content_islands.name: Connector rules
content_islands.spec: Place role, color and symbol guidance at left.

content_islands.name: Network bridge
content_islands.spec: Show a white T joining a magenta claim to a city photograph in the upper example.

content_islands.name: Community bridge
content_islands.spec: Reverse the relationship below, joining a sports crowd to a magenta message.

ingredient.name: T-Connector
ingredient.role: Join two related fields through the brand symbol.
ingredient.application: Use one white or magenta T-Digit without the registration symbol and cover the entire adjoining edge. Pair images that relate and add context.
ingredient.scope: Related image pairs and transitions; image-to-message/branding combinations are described for internal communications.
